answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the pulse queue naming the dune that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 6 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Thus, every alias costs 6 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the wharf record shows exactly who is still on probation. That is 12 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
